note: Budgets are provisional design targets. They are measurable planning numbers, not benchmark guarantees.

throughput_scenarios.description: 10 enabled strategy instances, one account, shared underlying plus selected contracts
throughput_scenarios.expected_behavior: shared market observations update once, then route to subscribed streams only

throughput_scenarios.description: same strategy family across two or more account sessions
throughput_scenarios.expected_behavior: account coordinators isolate reconciliation and authority decisions

throughput_scenarios.description: ordinary LTP/bid/ask/OI burst around ORPT or RC
throughput_scenarios.expected_behavior: ordinary updates conflate to latest state; critical ORPT/RC events are preserved

throughput_scenarios.description: multiple broker fills arrive close together
throughput_scenarios.expected_behavior: order streams serialize by client order and position projections serialize by position cycle
